- [Minimal UDT](#minimal-udt)

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  application-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:

    type: data
    format: tabular

```

import pandas as pd, scipy.io, numpy as np, time

sc=pd.read_csv(p+'/spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
meta=pd.read_csv(p+'/spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv', index_col=0)
A=sc.values.astype(np.int32)

for i,row in enumerate(A): cells_set.add(row.tobytes())
found=[]

for i in range(len(A)):

        if rem.min()<0: continue

            if len(k): found.append((i,j,k[0])); print('found',i,j,k[0]); break
    if found: break

import pandas as pd, scipy.io, numpy as np, gzip
from scipy.optimize import nnls
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
p='[REDACTED LOCAL PATH]'
sc=pd.read_csv(p+'/spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
meta=pd.read_csv(p+'/spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv', index_col=0)

cts=sorted(meta.cell_type.unique()); means={ct:sc.loc[meta.index[meta.cell_type==ct]].values.mean(axis=0) for ct in cts}
# all subsets up to 5, nnls and bic? print coefficients
from itertools import combinations
for k in range(1,5):
  best=[]
  for comb in combinations(cts,k):
    X=np.column_stack([means[c] for c in comb])
    coef,resid=nnls(X,y)
    rss=np.sum((X@coef-y)**2)
    best.append((rss,comb,coef))
  best.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
  print('\\nk',k)
  for rss,comb,coef in best[:5]:
    print(comb, np.round(coef,3), 'rss', round(rss,1))
